INSERT INTO sfo_investigations (citizen_id, reference, matter, status, opened_date)
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
           ON CONFLICT (citizen_id, reference) DO UPDATE SET
              reference = EXCLUDED.reference, matter = EXCLUDED.matter, status = EXCLUDED.status, opened_date = EXCLUDED.opened_date
           RETURNING (xmax = 0) AS inserted
